security_audit.summary: The guide intentionally recommends external CLI installation and remote inference commands, creating supply-chain and third-party processing risks. Most detections are Markdown fences or prose references without execution behavior.

remediation.issue: The guide recommends installing skills and running an external CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions, document trusted sources, and require user confirmation before installation or command execution.

remediation.issue: Prompts and source images may be processed by an external inference service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose external processing and instruct users to remove secrets, personal data, and confidential interface content before submission.

content.user_title: Create App Store Screenshots That Convert
content.value_statement: Store listings fail when screenshots use weak ordering, unreadable captions, or incorrect dimensions. This skill provides platform specifications, gallery strategy, generation prompts, and video guidance.
actual_capabilities: Provides iPhone, iPad, and Google Play screenshot dimensions and format requirements.
Organizes screenshot galleries around the first three visible positions.
Suggests benefit-focused captions and readable typography rules.
Provides remote image and video generation command examples.
Outlines localization priorities and Google Play testing practices.
Supplies a final quality checklist for store assets.
limitations: Requires the external belt CLI for generated images and videos.
Does not verify current Apple or Google policy changes.
Generated mockups may not accurately reproduce a real app interface.
Does not upload assets or configure store listings automatically.

use_cases.title: Launch a New Mobile App
use_cases.description: Plan a conversion-focused screenshot sequence with correct dimensions, captions, and preview video structure.

use_cases.title: Refresh Store Creative
use_cases.description: Replace outdated screenshots with benefit-led visuals that emphasize current features and differentiators.

use_cases.title: Prepare Localized Galleries
use_cases.description: Prioritize markets and define translated caption sets while preserving consistent visual structure.

prompt_templates.title: Check Platform Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: List the required screenshot sizes and formats for [platform] and [device type]. Include the maximum gallery count.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Screenshot Gallery
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ordered screenshot plan for [app type]. Prioritize [core value], [differentiator], and [popular feature] in the first three positions.

prompt_templates.title: Write Benefit Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Write concise, benefit-focused captions for these features: [features]. Keep every caption readable within two lines.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Localized Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a localized screenshot experiment for [market]. Define variants, gallery order, translation needs, test duration, traffic split, and success metric.

output_examples.input: Plan the first three screenshots for a habit tracking app.
output: Position 1: Show the completed daily routine with the caption Build Better Days.
Position 2: Highlight flexible reminders with the caption Stay Consistent Your Way.
Position 3: Present progress trends with the caption See Every Win Add Up.

output_examples.input: Create a 30-second preview structure for a finance app.
output_examples.output: Open with instant spending insight, demonstrate budget creation and alerts, show monthly progress, then close with the app icon.

output_examples.input: Recommend a localization approach for Germany and Brazil.
output_examples.output: Create translated captions for both markets, review text expansion, validate local currency screens, and prepare dedicated galleries when visual context differs.

best_practices: Lead with the strongest user outcome in the first screenshot.
Use current interface captures and verify every platform dimension before export.
Test one meaningful creative variable at a time with enough traffic and duration.
anti_patterns: Do not lead with settings, onboarding, or infrastructure screens.
Do not use dense captions that become unreadable in store previews.
Do not send confidential app data or unreleased interfaces to external models.

faq.question: Does this skill support both major mobile stores?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Apple App Store and Google Play screenshot requirements and gallery practices.

faq.question: Can it generate finished screenshots?
faq.answer: It provides belt CLI examples for remote generation, but final composition and policy review remain your responsibility.

faq.question: How many screenshots should I prepare?
faq.answer: Apple permits up to ten per localization. Google Play permits up to eight per device type.

faq.question: Why are the first three screenshots important?
faq.answer: They are visible before scrolling and should communicate value, differentiation, and a strong feature.

faq.question: Does it support localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends full localization for primary markets and translated captions for secondary markets.

faq.question: Are platform specifications guaranteed to remain current?
faq.answer: No. Verify dimensions, formats, and policies in current Apple and Google documentation before publishing.
